name: PT Itama Ranoraya Tbk
summary: PT Itama Ranoraya Tbk wholesale trades in laboratory and pharmaceutical equipment, and medical devices for humans in Indonesia. It offers in vitro diagnostics products comprising rapid test, serology, glucose diagnostic, NAPZA test, and clinical laboratory; medical imaging products, including bone densitometer, C-arm, flat panel digital detector, mobile and stationary x-ray, and mammography; nefrology, blood and transfusion, orthopedic, radiotherapy, and surgical products; and hospital supplies and hospital kitchen equipment.
